## Plan / implementation

1. `hh-monitor` (`approval.rs`, `decision.rs`, `wire.rs`, `monitor.rs`):
   `ApprovalOptionId::Modify` (the closed id set gains the C2 member),
   `ResponseChoice::Modify{amended_args}`, `Decision::Modified{
   amended_args}` + wire codec; `respond_inner` treats `modify` as a
   legitimacy-gated terminal decision (principal/`ApproverGrant`
   required — a delegate-voiced modify would burn the exactly-one owed
   decision); the served-decision fold restores `Modified` as a
   terminal fail (`recorded_modified:<pid>`);
   `ApprovalRequest.remedies` + `pending_payload` serializing
   `request.{options,remedies}`; the fold restores both. ADR-0343
   D1/D4.
2. `hh-monitor` (`ownership.rs` — new home): `OwnedObject{
   FsPathPrefix|ResourceKey}`, `OwnershipTable::project`,
   `WriteVerdict{Ok|NotOwner|Fenced}`, `check_write` — moved from
   `hh-subagent` (deps point downward; `hh-subagent` re-exports — CC1).
   ADR-0343 D3.
3. `hh-env` (`dispatch.rs`): `set_ownership_roots` arms check 8; at
   `prepare`, the write objects (canonical `path` of an `fs_write` +
   every `Resources::Declared` key) run `check_write` over the run-tree
   projection; a denial mints `security.policy.evaluated{check:
   ownership, verdict: deny}` + `action.effect.refused` +
   `action.tool.rejected` → `DispatchOutcome::Refused`. The recorded
   `modified` arm refuses the as-proposed effect `reason: modified`.
   (`egress.rs`): the egress ask mints `action.intent.anchored`
   (participant provenance, `ContentKind::EffectIntent`, run scope)
   durable *before* `security.permission.pending`; a `Modify` answer
   maps to a terminal refused egress outcome. ADR-0343 D1/D2/D3.
4. `hh-embed` (`work.rs`): `respond_permission` +
   `surface_respond_permission` map `PermissionOutcome::Modified` →
   `ResponseChoice::Modify` behind the `OptionNotOffered` gate (the
   durable offered set governs); `decided` carries `amended_args` +
   the `remedies` echo; the shared `approval_endorsement` helper
   resolves the anchor by `permission_id`, endorses to the responder's
   authority via `hh_provenance::endorse`, and appends
   `security.label.endorsed{basis: approval, basis_ref}` in the
   `granted` batch (`NoLabelIncrease` → nothing minted; other
   illegitimate → typed refusal). `pending_ask_from_row` decodes
   `request.options` (absent ⇒ the conservative pre-R2.11 set — never
   implies `modify`). ADR-0343 D1/D2/D4.
5. `hh-embed-schema` (`types.rs` + regenerated artifacts): the
   `PermissionOutcome` sum gains `Modified{amended_args}`
   (`PartialEq`-only — `Json` has no `Eq`); schema + generated client +
   compat matrix regenerated (CC7).
6. `hh-ledger` (`classes.rs`): `action.intent.anchored` registered
   (durable, provenance-required, non-audit-grade — the participant
   provenance must stay below kernel authority; hosted lowering
   `"hint"`); `DECIDED_FIELDS` gains bounded `amended_args`.
7. Batteries: `hh-env/tests/r2_11.rs` (8), `hh-embed/tests/r2_11.rs`
   (5). ADR-0343; DEFERRALS markers; BACKLOG BL-22/BL-23; COVERAGE
   R-2.8.7 → MET; closeout docs.

| anchor mints durable beside/before pending | `r211_ask_mints_intent_anchor_beside_pending` (hh-env) |
| recorded `modified` refuses the as-proposed effect | `r211_recorded_modified_refuses_as_proposed_effect` (hh-env) |

| own root admits | `r211_prepare_check_write_own_root_allows` (hh-env) |
| depth-3 ownership/delegation chain | `r211_depth3_ownership_chain_gates_at_prepare` (hh-env) |
| `Fenced` writer generation | `r211_prepare_check_write_fenced_refuses` (hh-env) |
| `ResourceKey` rival | `r211_prepare_check_write_resource_key_rival_refuses` (hh-env) |
| pure `check_write` agrees with the prepare gate | `r211_check_write_pure_agrees_with_prepare_gate` (hh-env) |
| `label.endorsed{basis: approval}` over the anchor | `r211_allow_mints_approval_endorsement_over_anchor` (hh-embed) |
| `decided{modified, amended_args}` + idempotent replay + `AlreadyDecided` | `r211_modified_outcome_mints_decided_with_amended_args` (hh-embed) |
| unoffered `modify`/`selected` refuse | `r211_modified_without_offered_modify_refuses` (hh-embed) |
| remedy-ingress echo onto `decided` | `r211_pending_remedies_echo_into_decided` (hh-embed) |
| no anchor ⇒ no endorsement | `r211_allow_without_anchor_mints_no_endorsement` (hh-embed) |
